questions.q: Why does a causal stack give (n - 1) // 4 + 1 latent frames?
options: Padding goes before the clip only, so the first frame has its own latent and the others fall in groups
It's a rule of the sampler
The clip is rounded to a power of 2
questions.answer: Padding goes before the clip only, so the first frame has its own latent and the others fall in groups
questions.why: The lab builds two causal stride-2 layers with conv3d and matches the formula for every length tested.

questions.q: You change only frame 20 of 21 in a causal stack. Which latent frames change?
questions.why: A causal stack has no path from later frames to earlier outputs. The lab shows just index 5 moving.

questions.q: Why does Wan 2.2's decode estimate have no frame count?
options: It decodes frame by frame with a cache of past features, a benefit of being causal
questions.answer: It decodes frame by frame with a cache of past features, a benefit of being causal
